import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Fix the type: module issue in the fresh clone before building
print("=== Fixing type module in fresh clone ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria_new/package.json')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria_new/server/package.json')
# Also fix the original
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria/package.json')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria/server/package.json')
# Now rebuild
print("\n=== Rebuilding ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria_new && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -15")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Start
print("\n=== Starting ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria_new/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 8 && pm2 list")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
